description: A `title` with a word in a host block, its key written `TITLE`. The compiler hands the name on as written and `setAttribute` lowercases it on an HTML element, so the user reads it as the host's `title`. The package carries `TITLE` too (measured through ngc in partial mode), so point 2 agrees only while both of its reads take the name in any case, and point 3 fires only while it does.
